questions.text:
Sapna invested ₹21,400 on simple interest, partly at 9% per annum and partly at 6% per annum. If
she earns equal interests from the two investments after 6 years, then find the sum invested at 9% per
annum (in ₹).

The average price of three items of furniture is ₹17,085. If their prices are in the ratio 3 : 5 : 7, the
price of the cheapest item (in ₹) is:

Three pipes A, B, and C can fill a cistern in 12 hours, 15 hours, and 20 hours, respectively. All three
are opened together. After 3 hours, pipe A is closed and after a further 3 hours, pipe B is also closed.
How much time will pipe C alone take to fill the remaining part?

A sum of ₹1,800 is to be divided among boys and girls in a class with a strength of 33. The total
amount of money received by boys and girls is in the ratio of 5 : 4, and the money received by each
boy and girl is in the ratio of 3 : 2. The number of boys is:
If tan θ = √11, then the value of (cosec²θ + sec²θ) / (cosec²θ − sec²θ) is:
Find the LCM of 0.14 and 0.36.

Two trains X and Y running towards each other cross a man standing on the platform in 31
seconds and 19 seconds, respectively. They also cross each other in 23 seconds. The ratio of the
speed of train X to that of train Y is:
A pair of socks marked at ₹240 is on sale for ₹180. Calculate the discount rate.

A dealer buys two articles X and Y for ₹2,500 each. He marks each of them at the same price. He
sells X by giving two successive discounts of 24% and 60% and still earns ₹478 as a profit. If he sells Y
at a single discount of 62%, then what is the profit percentage on Y?

The difference between the simple interest and the compound interest, compounded annually,
on a certain sum of money for 2 years at 10% per annum is ₹906. Find the sum.
Find the smallest number which when increased by 5 is divisible by 16, 24, 36, and 54.
If x = 3 + 2√2, find the value of x² + 1/x².

A mixture of 60 liters of wine and water contains 20% water. How much water must be added to
make water 25% of the resulting mixture?

A sum of ₹12,500 amounts to ₹15,500 in 4 years at simple interest. What is the rate of interest
per annum?

The compound interest on ₹10,000 at 20% per annum for 1 year, compounded quarterly, is
approximately:
m long?

A boat goes 30 km upstream and 44 km downstream in 10 hours. In 13 hours, it can go 40 km
upstream and 55 km downstream. Find the speed of the boat in still water.

A can do a work in 15 days and B in 20 days. If they work on it together for 4 days, what fraction
of the work is left?

A leak in the bottom of a tank can empty the full tank in 8 hours. An inlet pipe fills water at the
rate of 6 liters per minute. When the tank is full, the inlet is opened and due to the leak, the tank is
emptied in 12 hours. Find the capacity of the tank.

A student multiplied a number by 3/5 instead of 5/3. What is the percentage error in the
calculation?

The sum of the present ages of a mother and her daughter is 50 years. Five years ago, the
mother’s age was 7 times the daughter’s age. Find the daughter’s present age.
If a² + b² + c² = 2(a − b − c) − 3, then find the value of 2a − 3b + 4c.
If sin θ + cos θ = √2 cos(90° − θ), find the value of cot θ.
Find the sum of the infinite geometric progression: 12 + 4 + 4/3 + 4/9 + ...

A card is drawn from a well-shuffled pack of 52 cards. What is the probability of getting either a
King or a Heart?

In how many ways can a committee of 4 members be selected from 5 men and 4 women such
that at least 2 women are included?

By selling 33 metres of cloth, a shopkeeper gains the selling price of 11 metres. Find his gain
percentage.
If A : B = 2 : 3, B : C = 4 : 5, and C : D = 6 : 7, find A : D.

The average of 5 consecutive odd numbers is 27. What is the product of the first and the last
number?
A person crosses a 600 m long street in 5 minutes. What is his speed in km per hour?
What is the remainder when 2³¹ is divided by 5?

A rectangular field has a perimeter of 140 m and its length is 10 m more than its breadth. Find the
area of the field.
The ratio of the volumes of two spheres is 27 : 64. Find the ratio of their surface areas.
For what value of k will the system of equations 3x + 4y = 12 and 6x + ky = 20 have no solution?

A and B invest in a business in the ratio 3 : 2. If 5% of the total profit goes to charity and A’s share
is ₹855, find the total profit.

How many more students are enrolled in Engineering than in Arts?
What is the central angle corresponding to Science and Law together?
What is the ratio of students in Commerce to students in Law?
Which factory had the highest total production across all four quarters?
What is the average production (in thousands) of all five factories in Q2?
What is the percentage increase in total production of all five factories from Q1 to Q4?

In a certain code language, ‘MAID’ is coded as ‘4267’ and ‘MAIL’ is coded as ‘3742’. What is the
code for ‘L’ in that language?

This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers: (Left) 349 452 691 273 685 (Right). If 1
is subtracted from the first digit of every number, in how many numbers will the first digit be exactly
divisible by the third digit?

Each vowel in the word BOATING is changed to the letter immediately following it in the English
alphabetical order and each consonant is changed to the letter immediately preceding it. How many
vowels are there in the new letter-cluster thus formed?
What should come in place of the question mark (?) in the given series? RUW, PSU, NQS, LOQ, ?

If 1 is subtracted from each odd digit and 1 is added to each even digit in the number
352472537829, what will be the sum of the digits that are third from the left and second from the
right?

Each of L, M, N, O, P, Q and R has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and
ending on Sunday. L has an exam on Thursday. Only one person has exam between L and M. N has
exam on the day immediately before M but not on a Monday. Exactly two people have exams between
N and O. P’s exam is on one of the days before Q but on one of the days after R. On which day does P
have the exam?

If ‘A’ stands for ‘÷’, ‘B’ stands for ‘×’, ‘C’ stands for ‘+’ and ‘D’ stands for ‘−’, what will come in place
of (?) in: 22 B 12 C 5 D 15 A 3 = ?

A, B, C, D, L, M and N are sitting in a straight line facing north. Only two people sit to the right of
D. Only two people sit between D and C. Only three people sit between A and D. B sits to the
immediate left of D. N sits to the immediate right of M. Who sits at third position from the left end of
the line?

Each vowel in the word BEHAVIOR is changed to the letter following it in the English alphabetical
order and each consonant is changed to the letter preceding it. Which of the following letters will be
third from the right in the new group of letters thus formed?

Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike
in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?
Find the missing number in the series: 5, 11, 24, 51, 106, ?
Find the wrong term in the series: 8, 12, 20, 36, 68, 130, 260
Complete the analogy: 9 : 738 :: 11 : ?

In a certain code language, ‘FRIEND’ is written as ‘HUMJTK’. How is ‘CANDLE’ written in that
code?

If ‘A + B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’, ‘A − B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’, and ‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the
mother of B’, which expression shows that P is the maternal aunt of Q?

Kiran walks 10 m West, turns left and walks 15 m, turns left and walks 18 m, and finally turns left
and walks 9 m. How far is he from the starting point?

Six friends A, B, C, D, E, and F sit in two rows of 3 each facing each other. A is opposite D. B is to
the immediate left of A. C is at one end of the same row as A. E is opposite C. Who sits opposite B?
How many leap years are there between 1901 and 2000 (inclusive)?
Find the angle between the hour hand and the minute hand of a clock at 7:20 AM.

In a queue, Sita is 12th from the front and Gita is 17th from the back. If there are 8 people
between them (and Sita is ahead of Gita), how many people are in the queue?
If ‘+’ means ‘×’, ‘−’ means ‘÷’, ‘×’ means ‘−’, and ‘÷’ means ‘+’, evaluate: 15 + 4 − 2 ÷ 12 × 8.

Arrange the following in a logical order: 1. Interview 2. Notification 3. Joining 4. Application 5.
Merit List

How many such 5s are there in the following sequence that are immediately preceded by 3 and
immediately followed by 7? 3 5 7 2 3 5 6 3 5 7 8 5 7 3 5 7 1
If ‘CAT’ is coded as ‘24’ and ‘DOG’ is coded as ‘26’, what is the code for ‘LION’?
Find the next term in the series: A1Z, D4W, G9T, J16Q, ?

Five friends P, Q, R, S, and T scored different marks in an exam. P scored more than Q but less
than R. S scored more than T but less than Q. Who scored the second highest marks?

A man said to a lady, “Your mother’s husband’s sister is my aunt.” How is the lady related to the
man?
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the equation true? 16 − 4 × 3 + 12 ÷ 2 = 22

In a certain code, ‘743’ means ‘mangoes are good’, ‘657’ means ‘eat good food’, and ‘934’ means
‘mangoes are ripe’. Which digit stands for ‘ripe’?

A clock loses 5 minutes every hour. It is set right at 6:00 AM on Monday. What time will it show at
6:00 PM on the same day?
If ‘SILVER’ is coded as ‘TJMWFS’, how is ‘GOLD’ coded?

Six people A, B, C, D, E, and F sit around a circle facing the centre. A sits opposite D. B sits
second to the right of A. C sits to the immediate right of D. F is not an immediate neighbour of B. Who
sits to the immediate left of A?
In a row of trees, one tree is 9th from either end of the row. How many trees are there in the row?

Ram walks 20 m North, then turns right and walks 30 m, then turns right and walks 35 m, then
turns left and walks 15 m, then turns left and walks 15 m. In which direction and how many metres
away is he from his original position?

A painted cube of side 6 cm is cut into 1 cm cubes. How many smaller cubes have ONLY ONE
face painted?
